audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was nowhere on the page: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect that hits him. Cho'Gath's whole pattern opens with a knockup.
audit.why: Rupture is an immobilizing effect, so the first one Cho'Gath lands is simply eaten — he takes health loss and drops a chemical cannister instead. Walking over that cannister restores his health and reduces the passive's cooldown, so denying the pickup keeps the resist down. Every 'Q under his feet as he commits' instruction on this page assumes a knockup that does not land. Also unstated: Heart Zapper only heals him if its end-of-duration burst hits something, so leaving its 325 range before the burst denies the heal outright; and Blunt Force Trauma scales on his missing health, which inverts the usual read that a low-health bruiser is finished.
audit.corrected: His passive resists your first Rupture and drops a cannister — deny the pickup, then land the real knockup. Heart Zapper heals only if its burst lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; Feast was 'your committal tool' and Heart Zapper was tracked with no number.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17/16.5/16/15.5/15s, Infected Bonesaw 4s flat at 975 range, Blunt Force Trauma 9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6s, Maximum Dosage 120s flat. The 975-range 4s Q out-reaching Rupture's 950 is the reason the poke war is unwinnable and it was never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Windows keyed to Heart Zapper at 17s, Infected Bonesaw at 4s and 975 range, Maximum Dosage at 120s.

audit.corrected: Maximum Dosage heals a share of his missing health — Grievous Wounds before he hits 6.

notes: Riot's text says he can pick the cannister up by walking over it and that doing so restores health and reduces the passive's cooldown. It does not say an enemy can destroy or consume it, so I wrote 'zone the pickup' and 'stand on the pickup' rather than claiming Cho'Gath can take it. Whether Cho'Gath body-blocking the cannister actually prevents the pickup is not settled by the data — flagged as unverified. No drmundo__chogath mirror existed when I wrote this; the passive-eats-the-first-knockup point is the one that direction most needs.
